acts.label: Pun cycle 1: overtime -> 草 (grass) -> pasture world
Pun cycle 2: message to wrong group -> COW -> Holstein herd world
Pun cycle 3: work wasted 白干了 -> 白 (white) -> fresh milk world
Brand summary: three puns stacked into one slogan + logo
Meta epilogue: man vs milk-carton mascot, 'what's new' reveal + pack

beats.job: office problem: overtime lands at quitting time
curse-word pun: 草 becomes grass
pasture world: 48N golden milk belt grass
beats.on_screen_text: 北纬48度黄金奶源带 / 孕育多汁牧草

beats.job: tag line: good grass, good Yili
coda gag: man wants to eat grass too
office problem: boss message sent to whole group
shock-exclamation pun: reaction becomes COW
cow world: purebred Holstein herd grazing
beats.on_screen_text: 伊利优质奶牛 / 优选纯正血统荷斯坦牛 / 种源品质世界领先

beats.job: tag line: good cow, good Yili
coda gag: man in cow suit grazes
office problem: excited work declared wasted
beats.on_screen_text: 兴奋瞬间翻倍了 / 先别忙了 / 白干了

beats.job: wasted-work pun: 白 becomes white milk
beats.on_screen_text: 白 伊利优质乳蛋白

beats.job: milk world: hand-milking, natural pure milk
beats.on_screen_text: 源自天然 更显纯粹

beats.job: tag line: good milk, good Yili
coda: man drinks milk in the field
endorsement: stacked slogan then Yili logo
beats.on_screen_text: 好草好牛好伊利 天然营养好牛奶

beats.job: gag: man chases carton mascot with giant straw
meta problem: how is this ad any different
beats.on_screen_text: 和那些我这样拍广告 有什么区别 / 那你有什么新点子

beats.job: reveal + pack: versatile Yili nutrition
beats.on_screen_text: 只有百搭的伊利好营养

beats.job: channel end card: follow for good ads
beats.on_screen_text: 好看广告 一键关注，最好看的广告都在这里！

shape_note: Three identical cycles of office-problem -> exclaimed word turns into a pun (草/COW/白) -> Yili sourcing world -> '好X 好伊利' tag -> man-in-the-world coda, with office stakes escalating from overtime to public embarrassment to wasted work, then a stacked-slogan endorsement and a self-aware mascot epilogue that pays off with the pack.
